digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 22 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Rust, TypeScript, Python）和 12 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: obra/superpowers
repos.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI 编码 Agent 按成熟工程方法论工作的技能框架，把开发流程沉淀为可复用技能

repos.name: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills
repos.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
repos.summary_zh: 基于Karpathy对LLM编码陷阱的观察提炼成单文件CLAUDE.md，直击AI写代码常见坑点

repos.name: anomalyco/opencode
repos.description: The open source coding agent.
repos.summary_zh: 开源 TypeScript 编码智能体，让开发者用自然语言直接驱动代码生成与修改

repos.name: Graphify-Labs/graphify
repos.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex,
repos.summary_zh: 把任意代码库连同文档、SQL、配置和PDF转成可查询知识图谱的Claude Code等AI编码工具技能，本地确定性AST解析

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: xerj-org/xerj
repos.description: AI search engine and MCP server for bots and agents. One Rust binary indexes code, docs, logs, JSONL/CSV and PDFs for BM25 full-text, vector and hybri
repos.summary_zh: 单二进制 Rust 实现的 AI 搜索引擎与 MCP 服务器，统一索引代码文档日志并支持 BM25 与向量混合检索，让 Agent 无需 grep 即可搜代码

repos.name: stalwartlabs/stalwart
repos.description: All-in-one Mail & Collaboration server. Secure, scalable and fluent in every protocol (IMAP, JMAP, SMTP, CalDAV, CardDAV, WebDAV).
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的一体化邮件与协作服务器，安全可扩展，原生支持 IMAP、JMAP、SMTP、CalDAV、CardDAV、WebDAV 全协议

repos.name: AienTech/dossier
repos.description: A self-hosted job search app that writes tailored resumes and cover letters from your profile.
repos.summary_zh: 自托管求职管理工具，根据个人档案自动生成定制简历和求职信，一站式追踪申请进度

repos.name: kividbio/kividb
repos.description: A fast, multi-threaded Redis® and Valkey alternative written in Rust: drop-in compatible, with full-text and vector search built in
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 写的多线程 Redis/Valkey 替代品，可直接替换且内置全文与向量检索

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: vllm-project/vllm
repos.description: A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs
repos.summary_zh: 高吞吐内存高效的大模型推理与服务引擎，用PagedAttention显著提升吞吐并降低显存占用

repos.name: tashfeenahmed/freellmapi
repos.description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint
repos.summary_zh: 聚合34家免费LLM供应商与635个模型端点于单一/v1接口，自带智能路由、自动故障转移和密钥加密，月省74亿Token

repos.name: sgl-project/sglang
repos.description: SGLang is a high-performance serving framework for large language models and multimodal models.
repos.summary_zh: 高性能大模型与多模态模型推理服务框架，通过优化调度和内存管理显著提升吞吐与部署效率

repos.name: google/brotli
repos.description: Brotli compression format
repos.summary_zh: 谷歌开源的高压缩比无损压缩算法，比 gzip 体积更小解压更快，已被主流浏览器与 Web 服务器广泛采用

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: Folkbench/folkbench
repos.description: AI API 中转站评测排行与切换工具：实测可用率、延迟与价格 · Open-source AI API relay benchmark, rankings & switcher for Claude Code / Codex
repos.summary_zh: 实测各家 AI API 中转站的可用率、延迟与价格并生成排行，还能一键切换 Claude Code 与 Codex 的接入线路

repos.name: FrontiersMindAI/decisionformer
repos.description: Transformers for decision models: fine-tune, load and serve calibrated decsion-model on any Hugging Face model.
repos.summary_zh: 让决策模型像大模型一样微调、加载与部署，支持任意 Hugging Face 模型并输出校准后的决策结果

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: luongnv89/claude-howto
repos.description: A visual, example-driven guide to Claude Code — from basic concepts to advanced agents, with copy-paste templates that bring immediate value.
repos.summary_zh: 面向 Claude Code 的可视化示例教程，从基础概念到高级 Agent 全覆盖，附可直接复制的模板即拿即用

repos.name: refactoringhq/tolaria
repos.description: Desktop app to manage markdown knowledge bases
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台桌面应用，用本地优先方式管理 Markdown 知识库，让笔记整理像文件管理器一样直观高效

repos.name: claration/impactor
repos.description: Cross-platform & feature rich iOS/iPadOS/tvOS sideloading application. Formerly known as PlumeImpactor.
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台功能丰富的 iOS/iPadOS/tvOS 侧载工具，用 Rust 重写实现高效稳定的应用安装体验

repos.name: fabio-rovai/open-ontologies
repos.description: Plan, apply and roll back changes to a production ontology, with a blast radius report and a proof an auditor can re-check.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 实现的生产本体变更管理工具，支持计划、应用与回滚，并生成爆炸半径报告和可供审计员复核的证明

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: ruvnet/RuView
repos.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel
repos.summary_zh: 用普通WiFi信号实现实时空间感知、生命体征监测与存在检测，无需任何摄像头画面

repos.name: oven-sh/bun
repos.description: Incredibly fast JavaScript runtime, bundler, test runner, and package manager – all in one
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的超快 JavaScript 运行时，把打包、测试和包管理合为一体，一个工具替代 Node 生态多套工具链

repos.name: debpalash/VoiceStudio
repos.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook
repos.summary_zh: 完全本地运行的开源 ElevenLabs 替代方案，集语音克隆、设计、视频配音、听写、转录与有声书制作于一体，支持 646 种语言

repos.name: remotion-dev/remotion
repos.description: 🎥 Make videos programmatically with React
repos.summary_zh: 用 React 组件像写网页一样编程生成视频，让开发者以熟悉的声明式方式实现视频自动化制作

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Tool-Use Agents via Controllable Environment Synthesis
papers.abstract: We explore how to build performant large language model (LLM) tool-use agents that complete complex, multi-step tasks. Specifically, we study how data composition in synthetically generated tool-use e

papers.title: When Should We Intervene at Test Time?

papers.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents

papers.summary_zh: 提出面向自改进智能体的精选学习框架GEPA-Curator，通过区分提示缺陷与环境限制精准归因失败轨迹，显著提升多轮智能体任务优化效率

papers.title: Understanding the limits of latent world models

papers.summary_zh: 揭示潜在世界模型预测动态的局限并提出诊断方法，发现其在长时空推理中性能显著下降

papers.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstra

papers.title: VideoLVR: Latent Visual Reasoning over Grounded Video Evidence
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought reasoning has substantially advanced video understanding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, language-based reasoning traces do not provide a reliable mechanism for
papers.summary_zh: 提出基于视频证据定位的潜在视觉推理框架，让模型在思维链中持续回访关键视觉证据以缓解视觉遗忘，显著提升视频理解性能

papers.title: Pushing Dexterity and Safety for In-Hand Object Pose Reaching That Works Remarkably Well
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation with multi-fingered hands is the next frontier of robotics, yet learned hand skills remain limited to simple grasps or basic repeated motions, such as rotating an object. As rob

papers.title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
